bugs.title: PUT /api/users/me persists phone values outside the documented format
bugs.expected: A phone must begin with 0 and contain 10-11 digits; an invalid phone must not become the user's valid persisted phone value. Exact status and error schema are unspecified.
bugs.actual: The invalid values 012345678, 012345678901, 1123456789, 012345678A, +84123456789, and the empty string were observed as persisted phone values instead of remaining at the captured baseline.
bugs.reproduction: Authenticate as test@eshop.com, capture the profile baseline, PUT /api/users/me with one listed invalid phone and otherwise valid editable fields, then GET /api/users/me. Newman raw report records the assertion failures and repeated reproduction in the data-driven run.
bugs.confirmationStatement: Human confirmed the phone-format defect after reviewing the original failed partitions and clean targeted reproduction, including FR04-AI-013 and FR04-H-004.
bugs.note: Human-confirmed genuine bug. The verified phone contract requires a leading 0 and 10-11 digits, while the original and clean targeted executions observed invalid values persisted. The exact HTTP status remains unspecified. H-001/H-002 were corrected and remain outside this bug. Attested screenshot evidence is linked; external publication is still pending and no GitHub Issue has been created.

bugs.title: PUT /api/users/me accepts client-supplied protected account field changes
bugs.expected: Protected account fields must remain unchanged under FR-04/SEC-06 when the client submits attempted email or role changes.
bugs.actual: FR04-AI-026 changed the authenticated user's persisted role from user to admin. Independent clean FR04-AI-027 changed the persisted email and role from their ordinary-user baselines. Protected-field assertions and exact cleanup assertions failed.
bugs.reproduction: Authenticate as test@eshop.com and capture the ordinary-user baseline. For FR04-AI-026, PUT /api/users/me with role=admin and otherwise valid editable fields, then GET /api/users/me. For independently reseeded FR04-AI-027, PUT changed email and role values, then GET /api/users/me. Newman raw reports record the persisted protected-field mutations and cleanup failures.
bugs.confirmationStatement: Human confirmed the protected-field tampering defect after reviewing the clean FR04-AI-026 reproduction and independent clean FR04-AI-027 rerun.
bugs.note: Human-confirmed genuine bug covering the single protected-field mutation defect exposed by role and combined email/role cases. A freshly reseeded SUT returned baseline role=user; attempted role=admin persisted admin, and independent AI-027 also changed email. API cleanup cannot restore protected fields. Attested screenshot evidence is linked; external publication is still pending and no GitHub Issue has been created.
